diagnosis: Training and validation plateaued together. Most held-out confusion occurred among the four directional actions, especially action 3. The 2x2 adaptive pooling stage discarded spatial detail needed to distinguish directional expert actions; full inverse-frequency weighting also overemphasized the already perfectly recalled rare stop action.
changes_for_next_iteration: Retain a 4x4 spatial CNN representation before the recurrent layer.
Increase the map embedding from 128 to 256 features while preserving the 256-unit GRU.
